translations.web: In that day,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘you will invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree.’ ”
translations.bsb: On that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, you will each invite your neighbor to sit under your own vine and fig tree.’”
translations.kjv: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree.
translations.asv: In that day, saith Jehovah of hosts, shall ye invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig-tree.
